remarks: Welcome to Fairway Commons! This rarely available first-floor 1 bed, 1 bath unit combines comfort, convenience, and scenic charm. Step out onto your oversized private deck and enjoy peaceful water views-perfect for morning coffee or winding down at the end of the day. The spacious living area flows seamlessly into the kitchen and dining space, creating a warm, open layout ideal for everyday living. Enjoy the perks of in-unit laundry, generous closet space, and additional storage in the shared basement. The complex is professionally managed with flood insurance included in the common charges. One assigned parking spot with plenty of visitor parking. Just minutes to Ridgeway Shopping Center and walking distance to Scalzi Park, shops, and dining. Fairway Commons is a hidden gem where homes are rarely available-don't miss this opportunity!
